messages:
maria: small mypy/pyright blocker when using async client.

maria: repro: `res = await client.create_completion(prompt="hi")` then `res.result.choices[0]` fails statically. Generated type is `Optional[Union[CompletionResponse, List[CompletionResponse]]]`.

sophia: ah the single-vs-array-vs-none union again. Runtime ok, static checkers not.

jon: options: (1) normalize autogen to always return list, (2) add a typed wrapper with `.first()/as_list()`, (3) generate .pyi stubs/overloads for common endpoints.

tyler: non-breaking wrapper + a couple of overloads seems safest to start. Also avoid returning None for retry paths; prefer exceptions.

maria: I'll open a small PR for overloads on create_completion + a `ClientResponse` wrapper and add a mypy job in CI. Will document the autogen flag as a follow-up.

sophia: thanks — opening a sibling issue for streaming iterator typings (async for) would be helpful too.

maria: noted.
